_about: Field Watch reviews. The weekly search (tools/field_watch.py) only finds papers; it never judges them. After reading a paper, add it here under its id from field-watch.json (arXiv:2609.01234 or doi:10.xxxx/...). relation is one of: consistent, tension, independent-test, convergent, method, context, contact. convergent means the paper reaches the same specific, numerical prediction as one of ours by an independent route (a shared theme is not enough); add our_record with the date and DOI or URL of our earliest dated record of that prediction, and their_date, the date their work first appeared. test is the registered test it bears on. note is one or two plain sentences for the public page, written to the claims standard: a result that came before our written prediction is 'consistent', never 'predicted'. media.html shows reviewed papers first, with the relation and note.

arXiv:2609.01234.note: An independent BAO analysis that measures the same w0 and wa as our five-year prediction.

doi:10.0000/example.note: Derives the same w0 and wa band from a different starting point.
